items.summary: Recommend containment-only execution this cycle. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; $4.92 is aggregate and cannot be assigned to a site. AI usage is $945.25 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 across 5,264 calls, but matching-period revenue and infrastructure costs are unavailable. Contribution margin, budget exposure, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, forecasts, and causal lift are therefore unknown. Do not extrapolate revenue, treat aggregate earnings as site revenue, or authorize spend, billing changes, monetization expansion, or new work. Continue only existing period-aligned reconciliation and measurement using current telemetry.

Minimum evidence for contribution margin and cost-to-learn is a dated ledger matching each revenue and cost item to the same site or content identifier and period, including AI and infrastructure allocations, plus an approved learning threshold and measured outcome. The current brief lacks matching-period infrastructure spend, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, revenue floor, and approved learning threshold. Do not treat 45 pending measurements, 21 failed requests, 127 stranded work items, or 63% approved-proposal execution as financial performance.

Defer the execution-integrity control-plane concept this cycle. Its operational rationale is credible, but no incremental financial benefit, avoided cost, or implementation cost is evidenced, and delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. Reconsider only after capacity clears and a bounded business case specifies baseline cost, implementation effort, measurable savings or throughput benefit, and rollback.
